name: Russian CEE Kinetic and Sabotage Campaign

name: North Korean Agentic AI Cyber Espionage Operations

name: Ukrainian Strategic Counter-Refinery Deep Strike Wave

name: Storm-1516 / Matryoshka US Election Influence Cluster
summary: Russian state-sponsored influence networks deploy generative AI and synthetic media to manipulate political narratives and target election infrastructure during the U.S. midterm elections.

name: Vapor Panda ARTEX Agentic Campaign
summary: Chinese state-sponsored APT Vapor Panda utilizes the AI-powered ARTEX penetration testing framework to compromise sensitive developer platforms and government entities globally.

name: Volt Typhoon Silent Train Network
summary: Chinese state-sponsored espionage cluster utilizing SOHO/IoT proxy chains to breach critical infrastructure and exploit network management appliances.

name: Ivanti Connect Secure Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster

name: VOLTA Infostealer LLM-Powered Doxing Wave

name: AdFection Mercenary Spyware Campaign

name: PEERSTITCH Fortinet Edge Exploitation Wave
summary: Threat actors exploiting FortiManager vulnerabilities to exfiltrate configs and deploy in-memory malware PEERSTITCH.

name: Armory Castle Zero-Day Exploitation Cluster
summary: Chinese state-sponsored espionage group Armory Castle weaponizes remote support zero-day vulnerabilities.

name: PHP2Shell Global Remote Code Execution Wave
summary: Global exploitation of PHP heap corruption; threat actors chaining PHP2Shell to attack perimeter firewalls and web services.

name: SafePay Double-Extortion Campaign
summary: Ransomware operation targeting critical infrastructure globally; joint advisories confirm compromises across multiple organizations.

name: GhostAction CI/CD Credential Exfiltration Wave

name: APT28 European Defense Espionage Campaign
summary: Russian GRU (APT28) executing targeted intrusions against NATO defense contractors and military manufacturers.
